name: sg-llm-chat-input
description: Message input bar with file/image attachment support. Enter=send, Shift+Enter=newline. File picker, drag-and-drop, clipboard paste (Ctrl+V images). Attachment previews. Disables during in-flight requests, shows Cancel. Emits llm:chat-message.
notes: Uses Shadow DOM. Emits llm:chat-message (consumed by sg-llm-chat-history). Auto-resizing textarea. Image attachments → dataUrl, text files → textContent. Document-level paste listener for clipboard images.
